tip.title: INVERSION → AUXILIARY + SUBJECT
tip.ruleHtml: Si una expresión restrictiva o negativa abre la frase (rarely, seldom, only after, not until, only then), invierte: auxiliar + sujeto + verbo base.
tip.exampleHtml: Only after the call did she understand.
tip.contrastHtml: No: Only after the call she understood / she did understand · Sí: Only after the call did she understand.

questions.q: Only after the scan ___ the fracture.
questions.rule: Only after at the front triggers inversion; after did, use the base verb.
questions.trigger: ONLY AFTER → DID + SUBJECT + BASE VERB

questions.q: The system allows members ___ their own profiles.
The museum included audio guides, so we ___ one.
questions.rule: Needn't have means we rented one, but it was unnecessary.
questions.trigger: DID IT + NOT NECESSARY → NEEDN'T HAVE

questions.q: I'd rather he ___ the report before noon.
questions.rule: Would rather + another subject takes past simple.
Rarely at the front triggers inversion.

questions.q: If Paula ___ the map, she wouldn't have got lost.
questions.rule: Third conditional uses past perfect after if.

questions.q: The badge allows visitors ___ restricted areas.
Not until midnight ___ the server was down.
questions.rule: Not until at the front triggers inversion; after did, use the base verb.
questions.trigger: NOT UNTIL → DID + SUBJECT + BASE VERB

questions.q: The company covered the taxi, so he ___ a bus ticket.
questions.rule: Needn't have means he bought it, but buying it was unnecessary.
questions.trigger: DID IT + NOT NECESSARY → NEEDN'T HAVE

questions.q: I'd rather the children ___ indoors tonight.
questions.rule: Would rather + another subject takes past simple.
Only then at the front triggers inversion; after did, use the base verb.
questions.trigger: ONLY THEN → DID + SUBJECT + BASE VERB

questions.q: If we ___ the booking earlier, we would have paid less.
questions.rule: Third conditional uses past perfect after if.

questions.q: The app allows users ___ payments in advance.
Food was included, so you ___ sandwiches.
questions.rule: Needn't have means you brought them, but bringing them was unnecessary.
questions.trigger: DID IT + NOT NECESSARY → NEEDN'T HAVE

questions.rule: Seldom at the front triggers inversion.
